title: DAISY: Fault-Guided Assertion Inference for Dafny
abstract: arXiv:2511.00125v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Formal verification with Dafny provides strong correctness guarantees, but verification failures often require users to determine where helper assertions are needed and to manually write the assertions necessary for verification to succeed. This proof-engineering burden is difficult, time-consuming, and a barrier to the adoption of verification-aware languages.   We present DAISY (Dafny Assertion Inference SYstem), a tool for fault-guided assertion inference in Dafny.   Given a Dafny program and a target method, DAISY localizes likely assertion sites using verifier diagnostics, LLM-based localization, or their combination. It then annotates the program with assertion placeholders, retrieves relevant in-context examples, generates candidate assertions with an LLM, and validates candidates by running the Dafny verifier. translated_title: DAISY：面向 Dafny 的故障引导断言推断
translated_abstract: 使用 Dafny 进行形式化验证可以提供强大的正确性保证，但验证失败时，用户往往需要确定在何处需要辅助断言，并手动编写使验证成功所必需的断言。这种证明工程负担既困难又耗时，并阻碍了具备验证能力的语言的普及。我们提出了 DAISY（Dafny 断言推断系统），一个用于 Dafny 的故障引导断言推断工具。给定一个 Dafny 程序和目标方法，DAISY 通过验证器诊断信息、基于 LLM 的定位或两者的结合来定位可能的断言插入位置。随后，它使用断言占位符对程序进行标注，检索相关的上下文示例，利用 LLM 生成候选断言，并通过运行 Dafny 验证器来验证候选断言的有效性。为了评估 DAISY，我们扩展了 DafnyBench，通过移除辅助断言构造了验证失败的变体……
tldr: DAISY 是一个面向 Dafny 的故障引导断言推断工具，它自动定位需要插入断言的位置、利用大语言模型生成候选断言并通过 Dafny 验证器进行验证，从而减轻形式化验证中手动编写辅助断言的负担。
en_tdlr: DAISY is a fault-guided assertion inference tool for Dafny that automatically localizes assertion sites, generates candidate assertions with an LLM, and validates them using the Dafny verifier, thereby reducing the manual proof-engineering burden in formal verification.
